propositions: Compiled state maintains plan_review_phase (planning|execution) derived from winning process_status targets: in_progress sets execution, open sets planning, other targets preserve current value, with snapshot compaction and pre-feature bootstrap handling.

Manifest format requires exact ordered lines after advisory: review-phase (planning|execution) and for execution only priority-floor: 0.80, with comprehensive grammar validation through validate_review_phase_metadata rejecting duplicates, malformed tokens, and floors outside [0.0, 1.0].

Phase compatibility matrix enforces planning state accepts planning/legacy/execution attestations while execution state accepts only planning/legacy or execution with floor >= 0.80, returning phase_status (compatible|incompatible|malformed) on every validity result.

Pre-sign generation captured before LLM/probe is immutable baseline; unstable tracker HEAD retries at most three times with retry count/before/after logging; stable generation changes return terminal unsigned stale requiring re-review.

Plan-review workflow requires review_phase in precheck output and decide input schemas, threads it through both YAML decide branches, passes execution_review bool to Pass-3 to floor only blocking threshold when execution_review and blocking_enabled.

Re-sign recovery parses v2 JSON phase/floor through sidecar parser, compares result with compiled phase, refuses incompatible/malformed variants, and uses recorded review-time phase for manifest rebuild.
